direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels very controlled as this movie is really a drama that explores deeper issues of grief and loss, sprinkling in horror and mystery elements to make the movie adhere to the genre; The direction on a microscale is good as the movie is really driven by its lead characters navigating this tragedy and coming to terms with their grief; The storytelling is non-traditional as it is heavily inspired by 'Magnolia' in how different stories and lives converge to an end, showing how different people are navigating the tragedy; They build tension very well as you feel emotionally invested in the mystery, seeing how this movie ends

performance.comments: For being the most experienced person in the cast, I was actually somewhat disappointed in his performance; I personally just never felt like this character was written for him, as there is some disconnect when he is trying to act with others and show his own emotions; I mean, overall, his performance is pretty good because of the weight he has to carry, but I would have expected more from him
The real lead for the movie effectively shows someone spiraling to their vices to deal with grief and trauma as she tries to navigate this tragedy; elevates the people around her
Shows charisma and a pretty good range of emotions, as you can see how bottled up he is; Has good chemistry with Garner
Plays the drug addict character decently well, in somewhat of a comedic relief way

Does a pretty good job carrying the weight of his scenes on his shoulders, as he sometimes feels like the star of the show, the way he shows what the character is going through; I really hope he's okay after shooting this because he had to go through some really intense scenes
Decent performance and works well with the remaining cast, it's just he isn't given that much material to work with until the horror parts
A really sinister performance that makes all her scenes feel very uncomfortable;  Feels really manipulative and has good chemistry with Christopher

cast.comments: Everyone feels pretty elevated and does a good job portraying what they are supposed to, a town grieving from a tragedy and trying to find answers

story.comments: The concept is a horror mystery about a tragedy that affects a town, and the aftermath as people grieve and try to find answers; the plot structure feels inspired by non-linear films like 'Magnolia' as the movie follows different character-centered storylines that eventually converge to an ending; the character writing is surprisingly good as it individually deals with the grief, loss, and trauma these characters experience as they come to terms with the tragedy in their own ways

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is pretty polished and feels well written as it conveys the grief and loss these characters are experiencing; the symbolism is surprising for this movie as it is what separates this movie from being a straight horror movie as the movie touches on topics of grief, loss, and addiction; the foreshadowing is present, mainly from how the storylines are set up as each character shows how different characters experience the same situations

score.comments: Used mainly to build tone and help set up the horror elements

cinematography.comments: Made this movie feel like it had a big production budget, as it feels pretty highly produced; Helps with establishing horror elements

editing.comments: Made this movie feel like it had a big production budget as it feels pretty highly produced; It helps with establishing horror elements

sound.comments: Made this movie feel like it had a big production budget, as it feels pretty highly produced; helps with establishing horror elements

visual_effects.comments: Made this movie feel like it had a big production budget as it feels pretty highly produced; Helps with establishing horror elements; Some of the CGI and animation felt a little tacky

makeup.comments: Helps make the horror sequences scary and what they are

review.pacing: Pacing is right, as the movie feels engaging the entire time, as the plot structure helps you care about characters that are introduced and see things from their perspective
review.climax: Climax is executed well and definitely a horror spectacle, though there are some elements I would have liked to have seen better
review.tone: Tone is a drama that has mystery and horror elements sprinkled on it
review.overall: Overall, a very good movie that is really a drama that sprinkles in horror and mystery elements, as it explores deeper issues of grief and loss; And, this is mainly carried out through its 'Magnolia' style plot structure to show how different people are navigating the tragedy, with their stories eventually converging to a thrilling climax
